title_chain.headline: Title is unproven — deal-blocking
bullets: The foundational 1998 Vermillion agreement is an administration / co-publishing deal, not an assignment — rights revert to the writers on termination. Whether Northbridge ever owned the catalog is unresolved.
The 2017 Vermillion->Northbridge deed in the room is unexecuted (blank signature blocks); the master purchase agreement and all schedules/annexes are missing.
The masters chain rests on a 2014 Reston Vance / Capston assignment not in the data room.
No writer agreements and no copyright registrations exist anywhere in the room.

composition_count.headline: The composition count does not close.
composition_count.note: The 2017 assignment deed recites 40 compositions; the sale covers 32; the seller's internal inventory lists 60 works. The definitive schedule of assigned works was never produced.

rights_disputes.detail: Two conflicting split sheets; operative v2 (incl. Hassan Iqbal 12%) unsigned by 2 of 5 writers; Iqbal has counsel engaged, claims years of unpaid UK/US royalties
Naomi Tate's signed 4% share missing from the PRS registration since 2005; two written complaints ignored
Lena Akhtar (30% writer on the top earner) died 2022; share sits in PRS suspense; no estate contact
8% sample share 'signed' by a writer deceased 12 years earlier; controlling Bug Music side letter exists only as an illegible 2001 fax; internal note hints at a '2027 sample escalation'
Julian Petrov writes on all 32 songs (~25%); zero probate documents; estate bank details changed informally by post
3-year appointment (2018) never renewed; Pulse still issuing licences in 2021-22 (incl. BMW)

coverage_notes: GEMA (DE): 2021-2023 entirely missing — internally admitted lost; Germany booked at $0.
US mechanicals: HFA stops 2019-Q4; no MLC statements at all (2021 onward).
Atlantico (Brazil) silent since Q2-2023; no YouTube Content ID income ever reported.

recommendation.verdict: Do not proceed at the indicated basis.
closing_conditions: Executed chain of title (1998 -> 2017 -> today) with definitive schedules
PRS re-registrations and back-payment quantification (Tate, Iqbal)
Estate documentation (Petrov probate, Akhtar succession) with verified payment instructions
Legible Hammond / Bug Music sample clearance including any escalation clause
Holdback / escrow covering unquantified liabilities (Hammond escalation, GEMA black-box, accrued writer claims)
